items.title: A nice moment from the road: We caught up with Malcolm Arison on tour and gave him the Sonny Terry Edition harp.
items.excerpt: A nice moment from the road: We caught up with Malcolm Arison on tour and gave him the Sonny Terry Edition harp. Since Sonny is one of Malcolm’s all-time favorite players, it felt like the perfect match. Here’s a quick look at him unboxing it (plus a short sound check right afte…
